name: api_sync
description: Fetches all users (paginated) and each user's orders from the JSON API with 429 retry, saves raw data to <outDir>/api_data.json and writes <outDir>/totals.json (completed-order sums per user id). Returns counts.
whenToUse: To pull/refresh the users+orders API data and totals; raw data is cached in api_data.json for later questions.

countStatus.description: optional: also write per-user count of orders with this status

sumStatus.description: optional: also write per-user sums of amounts for this status (users with 0 omitted)

sinceDate.description: optional YYYY-MM-DD; only orders created on/after this date count for sumStatus

provenance.reason: many paginated/per-user requests with rate limiting
